name: University of Oxford
description: The University of Oxford is a collegiate public research university in Oxford, England, with evidence of teaching from 1096, making it the oldest university in the English-speaking world. It is organised into 39 colleges and four academic divisions.
whyIncluded: Among the most-searched overseas universities from Singapore in 2025 (KiasuParents, a Singapore parents' website), and on both the Singapore Medical Council (BM BCh) and the Singapore Institute of Legal Education (SILE) (BA Jurisprudence) recognition lists.

livingCosts.summary: The university's own estimate (midpoint of its range) of rent with bills, food, personal, social and study costs for a 9-month academic year. Transport is not counted separately.
livingCosts.notes: Oxford 'Likely living costs 2027-28' (latest published; single full-time student, no dependants), range midpoints per month: food £325-£560, accommodation incl. bills £880-£1,025, personal items £165-£320, social activities £50-£135, study costs £35-£95, other £20-£40; total £1,475-£2,175/month, £13,275-£19,575 for 9 months. Personal = personal items + social + study + other. Transport not itemised, so 0. www.ox.ac.uk blocks automated access; figures read from the Wayback Machine copy of this page dated 2026-09-07.
